row.notes: Unchanged status (none): Dropbox Sign's SAML SSO help article says 'Dropbox Sign does not currently support SCIM.' SAML SSO is Premium-only (custom quote). Prices unchanged: Essentials $15/mo (single user, $180 billed yearly), Standard $25/user/mo (from $600 billed yearly, 2+ users), Premium custom quote. No IdP provisioning connector found: Okta's 'HelloSign' OIN app offers SAML and SWA only. Team membership can be managed through the Dropbox Sign API (add/remove team members); API plans are priced separately (from $75/mo).
